cardNote: The included men’s rows reconcile to their published totals and FSGA ratings. Gold is withheld because its public per-hole values total 4,033 rather than the printed 3,973. The exact Quail Village boundary is kept distinct from the adjacent Quail Creek Country Club. OSM hole 7 is preserved with its incorrect raw par 3 tag and audited against the published par 4 card.
